fullPassage: It is our belief that the nature of medical education has fundamentally changed in the last two or three decades as has the nature of the practice of medicine. It would be odd if that were not the case, as education needs to evolve to provide the skills needed by practitioners to function safely and effectively in a changing healthcare environment. The reasons for change are complex. What we do know unfortunately is that levels of burnout, emotional distress, and substance misuse are very high amongst medical students wherever one goes in the world. This situation mirrors the one found amongst doctors of all grades working in different healthcare systems and cultures. Training for and practising medicine have always been stressful, but increased complexity in investigations, interventions, and management, along with societal changes and higher patient expectations has contributed to increasing levels of stress and distress. The big unknown is to what extent this is a developing phenomenon. Attempts to measure and identify distress and burnout in medical students have been fairly limited until recent years, so historical comparisons are generally not possible. There has been more research among practising doctors, and that does indeed suggest a worsening over time. It seems reasonable to extrapolate that the same will be occurring in students.

❌ ① practical — 실용적인 (의미축 다름)
❌ ② sincere — 진실한 (의미축 다름)
✅ ③ absurd — 터무니없는, 불합리한 (반의어) ←정답
❌ ④ evident — 분명한 (의미축 다름)
det.tip: reasonable(타당한) ↔ absurd(터무니없는): 같은 일이 학생에게도 일어난다고 추정하는 것이 타당하다

questions.passage:
(A) It is our belief that the nature of the <u>practice</u> of medicine has fundamentally changed in the last few decades.

(B) Daily <u>practice</u> is essential if you want to master a musical instrument.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 practice의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 의료 행위·업무 (명사) / (B) 악기를 익히기 위한 연습 (명사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (전문직의) 행위 — 연습 ←정답
❌ ② 연습 — (전문직의) 행위 (의미 뒤바뀜)
❌ ③ 관습 — 연습 (A는 '관습'이 아닌 '의료 행위·업무')
❌ ④ (전문직의) 행위 — 반복 (B는 '반복'이 아닌 '연습')
det.tip: practice: (A) 명사 — (전문직의) 행위·업무 vs (B) 명사 — 연습

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"the state of being extremely tired and having no energy, caused by working too hard for a long time"

det.korean: 장기간 과로로 인한 극심한 피로와 소진 상태 → burnout
det.analysis:
❌ ① comfort — 안락함 (소진 상태가 아님)
✅ ② burnout — (과로로 인한) 탈진, 소진 ←정답
❌ ③ leisure — 여가 (소진 상태가 아님)
❌ ④ reward — 보상 (소진 상태가 아님)
det.tip: burnout = (과로로 인한) 탈진, 소진 상태

questions.passage: Training for and practising medicine have always been stressful, but increased complexity in investigations, interventions, and management, along with societal changes and higher patient expectations has __________ (contribute) to increasing levels of stress and distress.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 스트레스 증가에 기여해 왔다 → 현재완료 has + 과거분사 → contributed
det.analysis: has __________ to → 조동사 has + 과거분사 자리 = 현재완료 → contributed
det.tip: contribute(기여하다) → contributed(과거분사): has contributed = 기여해 왔다

questions.passage: There has been more research among practising doctors, and that does indeed suggest a worsening over time. It seems reasonable to extrapolate that the same will be __________ (occur) in students.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 같은 일이 학생에게도 일어나고 있을 것이다 → will be + 현재분사(미래진행) → occurring
det.analysis: the same will be __________ → will be + 현재분사 자리 = 미래진행형(자동사라 수동태 불가) → occurring
det.tip: occur(일어나다) → occurring(현재분사, 자음 중복): will be occurring = 일어나고 있을 것이다

questions.passage: It is our belief that the nature of medical education has fundamentally changed in the last two or three decades as has the nature of the practice of medicine. It would be odd if that were not the case, as education needs to evolve to provide the skills needed by practitioners to function safely and effectively in a changing healthcare environment. The reasons for change are complex. What we do know unfortunately is that levels of burnout, emotional distress, and substance misuse are very high amongst medical students wherever one goes in the world. This situation mirrors the one found amongst doctors of all grades working in different healthcare systems and cultures. Training for and practising medicine have always been stressful, but increased complexity in investigations, interventions, and management, along with societal changes and higher patient expectations has contributed to increasing levels of stress and distress. The big unknown is to what extent this is a __________. Attempts to measure and identify distress and burnout in medical students have been fairly limited until recent years, so historical comparisons are generally not possible. There has been more research among practising doctors, and that does indeed suggest a worsening over time. It seems reasonable to extrapolate that the same will be occurring in students.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가장 큰 미지의 문제는 이것이 어느 정도까지 '점점 심해지는 현상(developing phenomenon)'인가라는 맥락이다. 뒤에서 시간에 따른 악화를 시사한다고 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① solved problem — 해결된 문제 (미지의 문제라는 흐름과 모순)
❌ ② permanent solution — 영구적 해결책 (문맥 무관)
❌ ③ minor detail — 사소한 세부사항 (심각성 강조와 모순)
✅ ④ developing phenomenon — 점점 심해지는 현상 ←정답
det.tip: the big unknown is to what extent this is a developing phenomenon = 어느 정도로 심화되는 현상인지가 미지수

questions.passage: It is our belief that the nature of medical education has fundamentally changed in the last two or three decades as has the nature of the practice of medicine. It would be odd if that were not the case, as education needs to evolve to provide the skills needed by practitioners to function safely and effectively in a changing healthcare environment. The reasons for change are complex. What we do know unfortunately is that levels of burnout, emotional distress, and substance misuse are very high amongst medical students wherever one goes in the world. This situation mirrors the one found amongst doctors of all grades working in different healthcare systems and cultures. Training for and practising medicine have always been stressful, but increased complexity in investigations, interventions, and management, along with societal changes and higher patient expectations has contributed to increasing levels of stress and distress. The big unknown is to what extent this is a developing phenomenon. Attempts to measure and identify distress and burnout in medical students have been fairly limited until recent years, so __________. There has been more research among practising doctors, and that does indeed suggest a worsening over time. It seems reasonable to extrapolate that the same will be occurring in students.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 학생의 고통과 번아웃을 측정·규명하려는 시도가 최근에야 이루어져서, 그 결과 '과거와의 비교가 대체로 불가능하다(historical comparisons are generally not possible)'는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① historical comparisons are generally not possible — 과거와의 비교가 대체로 불가능하다 ←정답
❌ ② current treatments are now widely available — 현재 치료법이 널리 이용 가능하다 (측정의 한계와 무관)
❌ ③ student performance has clearly improved — 학생 성취가 분명히 향상되었다 (문맥 무관)
❌ ④ future predictions are completely certain — 미래 예측이 완전히 확실하다 (측정이 제한적이라는 흐름과 모순)
det.tip: measurement가 limited → so 과거와의 historical comparisons 불가능 (인과 연결어 so)

ch: historical comparisons are generally not possible
current treatments are now widely available
